name: Alchemy
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign power in forming and refining creation, as seen in His creation of man from dust and the shaping of woman from man (Genesis 2:7, 22). While human attempts to transform or create, such as alchemy, rely on earthly materials, the Bible highlights God's authority over natural elements, demonstrated when He turned water to blood (Exodus 7:17). The refining process of precious metals, like silver and gold purified in a furnace, symbolizes the testing and purification of the believer's character (Psalms 12:6; Proverbs 27:21), pointing to a spiritual transformation that only God can accomplish.
